title: Utegymsindex 2026: outdoor gyms per 10,000 residents in Sweden's 290 municipalities
description:
Outdoor gyms and lit exercise tracks per 10,000 residents for every Swedish municipality, with rank. Counts from OpenStreetMap (extract 2026-11-13), population from Statistics Sweden (SCB, 2025). 92 municipalities have no outdoor gym mapped; Övertorneå has the most per resident (12.52). OpenStreetMap may miss unmapped gyms.

Method, charts and the full ranking: amblecoach.com/sv/data/utegymsindex.
